_comment: Tool roles of the FPGA flow (docs/spec/fpga-flow.md), by template: Vivado (Xilinx 7-series), Yosys + nextpnr (Lattice ECP5 / iCE40, open source). `q3tui tools init` copies them into the project's config/tools.json: edit the module or the command there.

fpga_synth.description: Vivado batch run of the Tcl script Q3TUI writes (read RTL + SDC, synth_design -mode out_of_context, reports)

fpga_yosys.description: Yosys on the script Q3TUI writes (read RTL, synth_<family>, JSON netlist, stat)

fpga_pnr_ecp5.description: nextpnr-ecp5 place and route, out of context, against the clock frequencies of the SDC

fpga_pnr_ice40.description: nextpnr-ice40 place and route against the clock frequency of the SDC (no out-of-context mode: the IOs are placed automatically)
